tg_netmaster: Sixty nets in this loft. Two came off a boat this week.
A net loft with nothing to mend is a city in trouble, and slowly.
The Foundation offered to buy the building. Politely. Twice.
tg_net_prentice: I was taught mending because there would always be mending.
Now they have me stripping good nets for the twine.
Nobody says it is over. Everybody is behaving like it is over.
